# At GOAMD64=v3 only the AVX2 check is omitted: the 8 and 16-bit
# slice sums keep their AVX512 guard. At v4 both checks are omitted
# while the masked tail loads stay. The v3 AVX2 omission and the
# scalar path live in logos_simd_feature_gate.txt and
# logos_simd_gate_branch.txt; this script pins the AVX512 level.
[!GOARCH:amd64] skip 'gate objdump needs amd64'

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOEXPERIMENT=simd

cd m
env GOAMD64=v3
logos build -o $WORK/exe3 .
go tool objdump -s '^main\.sumU8$' $WORK/exe3
stdout 'VMOVDQU8\.Z'
stdout 'AVX512'
go tool objdump -s '^main\.sumI16$' $WORK/exe3
stdout 'VMOVDQU16\.Z'
stdout 'AVX512'
logos run .
stdout '^sums ok$'

env GOAMD64=v4
logos build -o $WORK/exe4 .
go tool objdump -s '^main\.sumU8$' $WORK/exe4
stdout 'VMOVDQU8\.Z'
! stdout 'AVX512'
go tool objdump -s '^main\.sumI16$' $WORK/exe4
stdout 'VMOVDQU16\.Z'
! stdout 'AVX512'
logos run .
stdout '^sums ok$'

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/gateavx512

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

//go:noinline
func sumU8(xs []uint8) uint8 { return xs.sum() }

//go:noinline
func sumI16(xs []int16) int16 { return xs.sum() }

func oracleU8(xs []uint8) uint8 {
	t := uint8(0)
	for _, v := range xs {
		t += v
	}
	return t
}

func oracleI16(xs []int16) int16 {
	t := int16(0)
	for _, v := range xs {
		t += v
	}
	return t
}

func main() {
	us := make([]uint8, 70)
	ss := make([]int16, 70)
	for i := range us {
		us[i] = uint8(i * 3)
		ss[i] = int16(i*7 - 100)
	}
	if sumU8(us) != oracleU8(us) {
		panic("u8 sum mismatch")
	}
	if sumI16(ss) != oracleI16(ss) {
		panic("i16 sum mismatch")
	}
	fmt.Println("sums ok")
}
